# bodhan-genai — authoritative dependency lock (every modality, one environment).
#
# Generated by resolving the full dependency set cleanly and freezing the result:
#   ./install.sh
#   uv pip freeze          (CUDA-build wheels filtered, see below)
#
# Python 3.12.13, torch 2.11.0 (CUDA 12.9 wheels), transformers 5.13.1, vllm 0.26.0,
# ray 2.57.0, trl 1.6.0, peft 0.20.0, fastapi 0.136.3.
#
# ONE LOCK, EVERY MODALITY. TTS, MT and OCR previously carried separate locks on the
# belief that they could not co-install. They can: verified by resolving this set and
# running the whole suite against it (812 passed, 2 skipped — the 2 are gated on a
# checkpoint), plus importing all 86 TTS/MT/OCR modules for real under vLLM 0.26.
# The TTS stack was pinned to transformers 5.5.3 / vllm 0.19.0, but the TTS code only
# uses long-stable APIs (AutoModelForCausalLM, Trainer, TrainingArguments,
# LLM/AsyncLLM/SamplingParams) and already carried a version-tolerant AsyncLLM import,
# so the older pins were a snapshot, not a constraint. The last real conflict was
# tts-serve's exact fastapi==0.141.1 against vLLM 0.26's fastapi[standard]>=0.133,<0.137,
# which OCR's recognizer requires; relaxing that pin to the range resolves all three.
#
# The MT inference/eval pins are load-bearing: measured IN22 scores only mean
# something against a fixed runtime. The MT finetuning recipe is provisional
# (docs/mt/training.md); those pins are the set it was developed against.
#
# NOT PINNED HERE: torch, torchvision, torchaudio, torchcodec, vllm, triton, flashinfer
# and the nvidia-* CUDA runtime wheels. install.sh installs those explicitly from their
# own per-CUDA indexes before this file is applied. Pinning them here cannot work: their
# wheels publish a local version (`2.11.0+cu129`) that an `==2.11.0` constraint will
# not match, and hardcoding `+cu129` would break a CUDA_TAG override.
#
# flash-attn is deliberately absent and deliberately unpinned — see install.sh.
#
# Usage:
#   ./install.sh
#   # or by hand — vllm FIRST (it pulls its own matched torch), then the rest:
#   pip install vllm==0.26.0 --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/0.26.0/cu129 \
#       --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu129
#   pip install torchaudio torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu129
#   PIP_CONSTRAINT=constraints.txt pip install -e '.[all,dev]'
